DIAGNOSTIC BUILD: it FAILED its pre-registered gates and is NOT used (docs/research/work/perception-sprint-20261031/ev10w/README.md; PREREG.md committed in 3f058d2 before any ev10w number). The packed eval-10 policy keeps meshes/carve/ev10, which is unchanged. blue_cup: as ev10 (lathe wall wedges from the approach-2 profile, FlashCHORD CoACD hulls of library_v3 clipped below the inner floor), except below the coaxial seat line (h_diag = -z < -47.4 mm, profile s > 38.39 mm). There the cavity radius is r_in = min(max(r - 3 mm, R_g + 1 mm), r - 1.5 mm), where R_g is the max over f100-160 of the gl10A2 reference of the beige pieces' radial distance from the blue lathe axis. R_g (39.7-41.4 mm) lies outside the blue's own outer wall (34.4-36.6 mm), so the 1.5 mm wall cap binds in all 19 bins: the wall is 1.4-1.7 mm there (measured) and the cavity is 1.3-2.2 mm wider than ev10's. That band also uses 10 mm convex bands (band edges = profile bins) instead of one 60 mm band, which would bridge the widened cavity. Floor, outer profile and base hulls are unchanged. 89 pieces (ev10: 53). beige_cup: byte-identical copy of meshes/carve/ev10/beige_cup.
